page.layout: Printed page 789, a right-hand page. Across the top: the running head, then a two-line title block with an italic explanatory line below it. Below that: two columns of index entries, left and right. The gutter at the left edge cuts off the first letters of the left column. Signature at the lower centre, catchword at the lower right.

page.notes: The gutter at the left edge hides the first letters of the left column, so those entries begin as fragments and are kept as fragments. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: "essione" (the long s printed like f in italic, read as s). The faint line above the ornament reads AXIOMATUM SYLLABUS and is taken as the running head, though it is light. Number placement in the left column is partly lost in the gutter, so the separation of some numbers from their entries is uncertain. The "2" after "sequitur, 691" and the "6" after "584," sit on their own lines in the scan and are kept that way. The catchword "per" is the word of the next column's first entry; it is at the lower right as printed.
